assembly_notes: Hand-crank clothes wringer with one rigid frame, an exposed geared horizontal roller bank, two vertically sliding pressure-bearing carriers, and a side crank. The five independent core slots are support_mount (4), pressure_mechanism (4), crank_style (2), feed_module (2), and roller_bank (1), giving 4*4*2*2*1 = 64 core combinations. roller_count is multiplicity N in {2,3}, so raw coverage is 128. N=2 emits one fixed lower roller and one pressure-carried upper roller; N=3 emits two fixed rollers and one pressure-carried upper roller, with every roller receiving a real bored bearing pair and registered continuous spin joint. The frame height, fixed bearing rows, upper carrier position, top beam, pressure bridge, crank axis, and exposed gear train all derive from N and roller radius, so no combination is gated. The fixed crank is one part; the folding crank adds a separate bounded-revolute handle. The plain apron is welded to the frame; the shelf adds a separate bounded-revolute feed part. Clamp, floor, and wall supports alter the primary mounting silhouette independently. The exposed-twin-gear fork is deliberately rejected as a duplicate of the origin rather than counted as a false candidate. roller_length_m, roller_radius_m, and frame_height_m are continuous, and palette is non-core.

multiplicities.name: roller_count
multiplicities.spacing_expression: roller i uses z_i = lower_axis_z + i*(2*roller_radius_m + 0.002); the top indexed roller is pressure-carried and all lower indexed rollers are frame-carried
multiplicities.host_capacity_expression: top beam and side rails derive upward from upper_axis_z = lower_axis_z + (roller_count-1)*(2*roller_radius_m+0.002), plus pressure travel, bearing half-height, and 14 mm headroom

candidates.name: classic_boss_clamps
candidates.evidence: Two compact bored bosses under the beam carry prismatic clamp screws and broad pads.

candidates.name: reinforced_table_clamps
candidates.evidence: Deep brackets, triangular gussets, threaded bushings, retained pads, and cross handles visibly replace the compact boss mounts.

candidates.name: freestanding_floor_frame
candidates.evidence: Four tall legs terminate in paired foot bars and pads and are tied by base crosses and diagonal braces.

candidates.name: wall_bench_bracket
candidates.evidence: A rear plate with four mounting bolts and two triangular gussets creates a compact wall or bench installation topology.

candidates.name: centre_screw
candidates.evidence: One threaded stem passes through the top beam and carries a cross handle and hub.

candidates.name: overhead_screw_bridge
candidates.evidence: Twin posts and gussets support a crossbar and bushing; a knurled screw drives a pressure bar with two pads.

candidates.name: spring_loaded_bridge
candidates.evidence: Guide posts, bridge bar, two helical springs, and seats visibly load the moving bearing blocks.

candidates.name: dual_handwheels
candidates.evidence: Two handwheel parts turn above the bearing lines on threaded posts tied by a transverse bar.

candidates.name: fixed_bent_crank
candidates.evidence: A single crank-drive part carries the swept bent arm, long grip, and end cap.

candidates.name: folding_park_crank
candidates.evidence: A crank stub with hinge ear and pin carries a separate handle through a bounded revolute park joint.

candidates.name: plain_front_apron
candidates.evidence: The baseline has only a narrow fixed front apron ahead of the nip.

candidates.name: fold_down_shelf
candidates.evidence: A broad perforated shelf with hinge barrels and side stops folds against frame knuckles on a bounded axis.

candidates.name: indexed_parallel_roller_bank

parameters.name: roller_length_m
parameters.rationale: rubber roller face width; derives beam span, bearing planes, and support footprint

parameters.name: roller_radius_m
parameters.rationale: roller radius; derives nip pitch, bearing height, gear tip radius, and host height

parameters.name: frame_height_m
parameters.rationale: requested frame height before roller-count headroom derivation

parameters.name: bearing_plane_x_m
parameters.rationale: bearing blocks remain just outboard of the rubber face

parameters.name: nip_centre_distance_m
parameters.rationale: adjacent roller axes remain one diameter plus the closed wringing gap apart

candidates.evidence: One index-general loop emits every roller, its two bearing interfaces, and a registered spin joint; N=3 proves real part, joint, and host growth while the origin supplies N=2.
candidates.notes: The single candidate owns the placement law. roller_count is multiplicity and therefore excluded from core arithmetic.
